visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of grilled steak slices being arranged over a bed of white rice in a metal pot. An onion and egg mixture is poured generously over the steak. (2) Transition to a white plate where raw beef slices are being seasoned with salt and pepper. (3) A hand is seen throwing sliced white onions into a heated pot with oil, then stirring them with a metal spoon. (4) Sliced mushrooms are added to the softened onions and stirred continuously. (5) Liquid seasoning (soy sauce) and spices from bottles labeled Tesco are added to the pot. (6) A beaten egg mixture is poured over the cooked onions and mushrooms, creating a thick sauce. (7) Sliced steak pieces are placed into a frying pan with oil, sizzling as they are cooked and turned with chopsticks. (8) The cooked steak slices are carefully placed one by one onto steamed rice in a circular metal pot. (9) The prepared onion, mushroom, and egg sauce is poured over the steak. (10) A young woman with dark hair and a grey sweater sits at a table, takes a large bite of the steak rice, and gives a thumbs-up gesture while nodding happily.

A friendly female voice begins narrating at a moderate pace. (2) A sharp metallic clink occurs as ingredients are added to a pot, followed by continuous stirring sounds. The BGM remains consistent in volume. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound (higher frequency splash) is heard as water or sauce is added. (4) Another liquid pouring sound occurs, more viscous, indicating the egg mixture. The narrator's pitch rises with enthusiasm. (5) A loud, broadband sizzling sound dominates for several seconds as the steak hits the hot pan. (6) Soft scraping and clinking of chopsticks against metal are heard as the dish is assembled. (7) Final phase includes the sound of a bite and a crunch, followed by a bright, high-arousal vocal exclamation ('Haoshi!') signaling satisfaction.
